integrity: Exact signed cellular boundary matrices, unimodular determinants and all 24 symmetry transformations verified in packaged standalone checker. The abstract homology rank is established in earlier literature; novelty claim is the integral equivariant lattice and its nonsplitting.
scientific_limitations: Only the unordered two-particle configuration space on the tetrahedral graph and its integral first homology; no extension to higher particle numbers. The module has not received independent verification. Unindexed literature may overlap.
title: The tetrahedral two-particle homology lattice is a signed \(D_4\) dual lattice
